# Close Recap, Thu Nov 12, 2026 (pulled ~4:18 PM ET)

**Huang resigned, NVDA was bought, then rates and a hawkish Fed faded the rally. Small caps were hit hardest.** Nvidia confirmed Jensen Huang's resignation at 8:48 and named Colette Kress interim CEO. NVDA opened at a low of **149.27 (−14%)**, ripped to 167.14 by 11:12 and closed **166.19 (−4.3%)**. Index ETFs opened below their PDLs, held the pre-market lows, and squeezed to the morning upside targets by 11:20–11:23 (SPY 763.0, QQQ 694.6). They then bled lower all afternoon as the 30-year auction tailed (5.441%), the 10-year hit 5.12% and Daly said "further tightening will be needed." **SPY −0.35%, QQQ −0.32%, IWM −1.64%.** IWM closed at its low of the day. VIX **18.78 (+7.4%)**.

Sources: the Quant Data API on the user's account (GEX by strike, dark pool, 9k+ unconsolidated flow; pulled 4:17 PM ET), Yahoo Finance (1m/15m bars, futures, indexes, VIX, yields, DXY, oil, gold, stocks), the Financial Juice RSS feed, and X News. **Caveats:** the browser My Pages weren't opened, so the 'contract flow' Session Date wasn't touched. The Financial Juice feed only reached back to 11:55, so headlines from 9:00 to 11:55 come only from X News. Team2Trading's X feed wasn't checked.

- **10-year 5.10% (+10 bp)**, high 5.12% at 14:02. The **30-year auction** high yield was **5.441%** vs 5.437% when-issued (a small tail), and bid-to-cover was **2.36** vs 2.54 prior.
- **DXY 103.17 (+0.3%).**
- **WTI settled $88.74 (+2.6%)**, **Brent $95.82 (+3.3%)** (Financial Juice), even though EIA showed a crude **build of +4.66M** vs a −1.48M estimate.
- **Gold 3878 (−3.1%)**. Bitcoin fell below $72k (X News).

**Movers:** **AMD +5.9%, AVGO +5.5%** (bid all day as NVDA alternatives), GOOGL +1.8% (Gemini 4 rolled out in Search at 13:05), TSLA +1.7% (SpaceX–Tesla merger talks reported progressing at 15:09). Laggards: **CRWV −6.9%, RGTI −7.0%, AMAT −3.6%, MRVL −2.6%, INTC −2.1%, MU −1.6%, SMH −1.0%**, META −0.8%.

## Morning levels: held or broke
- **SPY** (updated PM range 752.8–757.6, PDL 754.93):
  - **Opened below the PDL**, with a low of 753.67 at 9:30. The **752.8 PML held** and the 750 put node never came into play.
  - **754–755 shelf reclaimed** in the first bar (the 9:30 15-min bar closed 757.45).
  - **757.6 PMH broke** on the 10:30 bar (758.55 close). The **759.8–761 target hit** at 10:45 (760.78 close).
  - **762.5 PDH: swept, not broken.** The high was 763.04 at 11:23, but the 15-min bodies closed 762.04 and 761.90, a 15-min sweep of the PDH. It faded from there to close **757.20, on the 757 put node**.
- **QQQ** (PM range 679.1–686.3, PDL 683.64):
  - **The 679–680 line held**: low 679.84 at 9:31, right on the 680 put node, above the 679.14 PML.
  - **683.6 PDL and 686.3 PMH reclaimed in the first bar** (the 9:30 bar closed 686.73). The 690 PDC target hit at 10:45 (691.78 close).
  - The **692.9 untested rejection broke** at 11:00 (692.98 close), but the high of 694.56 at 11:20 **stalled about 1 point under the 695.5 PDH**. It closed **688.21, back below the 690 band**.
- **IWM** (PM range 280.55–283.18, PDL 281.48):
  - **The 283.2–284 lid was never tested** (the high was 282.20 on the open).
  - **The 280.55 PML broke** on the 9:45 bar (279.87 close). The **279–280 target hit** (low 278.67 at 10:15).
  - The bounce to 281.87 at 11:00 **failed at the 281.5 PDL**. Then it slid all afternoon through 278.67 and the **278.4 untested support**, to a low of 278.04 at 15:55. It closed 278.46, the weakest of the three.

## Drivers (ET; Financial Juice unless noted)
- **Nvidia:**
  - 8:48: CEO transition. Huang resigned, Kress is interim CEO, and per X News Harvey Jones is chair. Earnings stay on Nov 17.
  - 12:02: Democrats will probe chip export approvals (CNBC).
  - 13:57: the new CEO plans a company meeting next Wednesday (WSJ).
  - 14:10: Sen. Reed asked whether Nvidia is "too big to fail."
  - 14:25: a report of a second relationship with an employee.
  - 15:43: AG Blanche said DOJ hasn't concluded whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy.
  - 15:53: Nvidia will continue its investigation (The Information).
  - 11:55: the US is probing whether Alice Huang helped smuggle Super Micro products.
  - X News: Chinese AI firms are rushing to rent overseas Nvidia capacity on fears of tighter remote-access curbs.
- **Rates / Fed** (lines up with the afternoon fade):
  - 13:01: the 30-year auction was weak (see above).
  - 13:34–13:48: **Daly:** "bias is that further tightening will be needed," "inflation pressure is up, not down," and she's comfortable with the Sept. hike.
  - 13:46: Schmid said the Fed "still hasn't beat the inflation enemy."
  - 8:42: Hammack was hawkish in the morning.
  - 13:58: the federal budget balance was −$404B vs −$317.5B est.
- **Iran / oil:**
  - 11:57: the Houthis claim they attacked a Saudi Yanbu oil facility and an east–west pipeline pumping station.
  - 13:40–14:05: explosions and an "enemy" attack on Iran's Sirik in Hormozgan (Fars/IRNA, called "military" in nature). The 10-year's 5.12% high came at 14:02.
  - 15:28: Trump said he would "possibly" use military force in Iran if needed and would consider a campaign against Cuba.
- **Data:** jobless claims were 200k vs 194k est. Freddie Mac 30-yr mortgage 7.11% (from 7.18%).
- **Other:** 11:59: the Fed dropped the October 2027 FOMC meeting from its calendar. 15:09: SpaceX–Tesla merger discussions are progressing, with a deal possible as early as December. 16:05: the Anthropic IPO is about 6× oversubscribed.

- **QQQ (5):** **14:56 Dec 31 715C sold at the bid (opening) vs 725C bought back (closing), 38k**: a short call rolled down closer to spot, which caps the upside. Dec 18 750C 10k crosses (closing).

- **VIX (11):** Dec 16 19C/20C/21C prints at the ask (~$10M) at 14:18–15:29, all flagged closing, as VIX climbed.
- **NVDA (28; $287M calls / $225M puts):**
  - **9:47–9:52: calls rolled down into the drop and opened at the ask**: Mar '27 175C 38.9k ($55.7M) vs 225C sold, and Mar '27 170C 35k ($59.2M), vs Dec 185C / Mar 185C closed.

- **Read:** index flow was light, with no heavy at-the-bid index put selling like the setups before past snap-backs. Size was in NVDA: dip-buyers rolling calls down and opening, and put holders taking profit. That fits the 9:30–11:20 rebound. The QQQ short-call roll to 715 and the IWM put roll after the close lean defensive into Friday.
